{{Short description|Type of uniform tiling in geometry}}
{{Uniform hyperbolic tiles db|Uniform hyperbolic tiling stat table|Uii_s}}
In [[geometry]], the '''snub apeiroapeirogonal tiling''' is a uniform tiling of the [[Hyperbolic geometry|hyperbolic plane]]. It has [[Schläfli symbol]] of s{∞,∞}. It has 3 equilateral triangles and 2 [[apeirogon]]s around every vertex, with [[vertex figure]] 3.3.∞.3.∞.

== Dual tiling ==
[[File:Infinitely-infinite-order floret pentagonal tiling.png|320px]]

== Related polyhedra and tiling ==
{{Order i-i tiling table}}

The ''snub tetrapeirogonal tiling '' is last in an infinite series of snub polyhedra and tilings with [[vertex figure]] 3.3.''n''.3.''n''.
{{Snub5 table}}
